name: Nassau
tagline: Colourful colonial port of turquoise water and conch
summary: Nassau is the Bahamas' capital, with pastel colonial streets, forts and some of the world's clearest water. Climb the Queen's Staircase, swim at Cable Beach or Paradise Island, eat conch salad at the Arawak Cay fish fry, and take a day trip to swim with the famous pigs of the Exumas.
seasonNote: December to April is dry and sunny; June to November is hurricane season.
arrival: Lynden Pindling International is 25 minutes from downtown; cruise ships dock at Prince George Wharf.
gettingAround: Jitney buses and taxis; water taxis to Paradise Island.
cashTip: The Bahamian dollar is pegged 1:1 to the US dollar and both are used everywhere. Cards work at resorts; carry cash for the fish fry and jitneys.
foodTip: Conch salad, cracked conch, guava duff and rum punch.
buyTip: Straw market crafts and local rum.
baseArea: Cable Beach, Paradise Island or downtown
